focus_display_name_missing_created.impact: In game the focus shows as its ID, with no tooltip text.

focus_display_name_missing_enabled_local.impact: Players using that language will see the ID.

focus_initial_position_unknown_kind.what: The initial position type of {tree} is not recognized
focus_initial_position_unknown_kind.impact: The whole focus tree may shift or overlap itself.

focus_reward_modifier_in_effect_position.what: In the completion reward of focus {id}, {token} is a modifier but sits in an effect position
focus_reward_modifier_in_effect_position.impact: The game ignores the line on load — it does not take effect.
focus_reward_modifier_in_effect_position.action: Move it into a modifier carrier

focus_reward_scalar_effect_block_value.what: {token} in focus {id} expects a number but got a code block (or the reverse)
focus_reward_scalar_effect_block_value.impact: The line does not take effect.

focus_reward_trigger_in_effect_position.what: The completion reward of focus {id} contains the condition {token}; this position only accepts effects
focus_reward_trigger_in_effect_position.impact: The line does not take effect and the condition is never evaluated.
focus_reward_trigger_in_effect_position.action: Move it into the condition block

focus_reward_unsupported_scope.what: {effect} in focus {id} is not supported in the current scope ({scope})
focus_reward_unsupported_scope.impact: The effect does not fire. Supported scopes: {supported}.
focus_reward_unsupported_scope.action: Wrap it in a supported scope

focus_base_default_provider_unresolved.what: The default focus tree provided by the base mod could not be found
focus_base_default_provider_unresolved.impact: The focus tree may not attach to the right country and stays invisible in game.

focus_effective_default_missing.impact: The country falls back to the generic tree — players never see the tree you built.

focus_file_policy_applied.what: Focus tree output files were written as recorded

focus_file_policy_cohort_incomplete.what: {tree} was not exported together with the other focus trees in its file
focus_file_policy_cohort_incomplete.impact: The file is only partially written — the missing trees do not appear in game.

focus_file_policy_drift.what: The file policy of {tree_ids} does not match the version record
focus_file_policy_drift.impact: No impact on the output; exported per the current policy. This field is system-maintained — no change needed.

focus_file_policy_duplicate_membership.what: Internal record conflict: one tree carries two file policies
focus_file_policy_duplicate_membership.impact: The UI will show “check incomplete”; reported automatically.

focus_file_policy_missing.what: {id} has no output file; one was assigned automatically
focus_file_policy_missing.impact: No impact on the game; content is complete.

focus_initial_position_target_missing.what: The initial position of {tree} points to focus {id}, which does not exist in that tree
focus_initial_position_target_missing.impact: The tree opens with a misplaced initial view, showing an empty area.

focus_raw_file_parse_failed.what: Focus file {path} has a syntax error and cannot be read
focus_raw_file_parse_failed.impact: All focuses in this file will be missing.
focus_raw_file_parse_failed.action: Fix the syntax (jump to the failing spot)

focus_registry_unavailable.what: The vanilla focus registry failed to load; the file check did not finish
focus_registry_unavailable.impact: The UI will show “check incomplete”; this export took the conservative path; reported automatically.

timeline_bookmark_path_shadow_date_misma.what: Two bookmark files write to the same path with different dates; only one takes effect
timeline_bookmark_path_shadow_date_misma.impact: The start date may differ from what you set.

timeline_custom_start_without_bookmark.what: A custom start date is set, but it has no matching bookmark
timeline_custom_start_without_bookmark.impact: Players do not see this start on the campaign selection screen.

timeline_project_earliest_bookmark_misma.what: The project start date ({a}) differs from the earliest bookmark date ({b})
timeline_project_earliest_bookmark_misma.impact: The game starts on the bookmark date.

timeline_project_start_date_unknown.what: The project has no start date
timeline_project_start_date_unknown.impact: The export uses the default date.

timeline_raw_bookmark_date_unknown.what: No date could be parsed from the bookmark file
timeline_raw_bookmark_date_unknown.impact: The bookmark is exported as-is and skips the date consistency check.

timeline_raw_bookmark_hash_mismatch.what: The bookmark file was modified outside the program and differs from the record
timeline_raw_bookmark_hash_mismatch.impact: Check results may not reflect the file's real content.

timeline_raw_defines_start_date_conflict.what: The start date in the defines file ({a}) conflicts with the project setting ({b})
timeline_raw_defines_start_date_conflict.impact: The game starts on the bookmark date, but campaign length, world tension and similar mechanics run from the defines date — a mismatch skews them all.

timeline_start_date_ok.impact: The game starts on this project's start date.

timeline_structured_bookmark_date_unknow.what: No date could be parsed from the bookmark
timeline_structured_bookmark_date_unknow.impact: The bookmark skips the date consistency check.

clausewitz_parse_error.what: {file} has a syntax error and cannot be read
clausewitz_parse_error.impact: The entire file is left out of the mod.

clausewitz_unclosed_block.impact: Everything after this line will be lost.

clausewitz_stray_closing_brace.impact: Following content may land in the wrong block.

clausewitz_unterminated_quote.impact: The line and everything after it is read as one string.

raw_content_literal_escape_newline.what: {file} line {line}: literal \n (backslash + n) in script text
raw_content_literal_escape_newline.impact: HOI4 script does not interpret escapes — players will see the two characters \n verbatim.
raw_content_literal_escape_newline.action: Use a real line break, or move the text into a localisation yml value where \n is a newline

clausewitz_missing_assignment_value.impact: The setting does not take effect.

clausewitz_analysis_ast_mismatch.what: Parser self-check mismatch; results for this file may be incomplete
clausewitz_analysis_ast_mismatch.impact: The UI will show “check incomplete”; reported automatically.

clausewitz_analysis_token_alignment.what: Parser token alignment failed; results for this file may be incomplete
clausewitz_analysis_token_alignment.impact: The UI will show “check incomplete”; reported automatically.

country_capital_missing.impact: Capitulation, the supply network and political power all anchor on the capital — without one, all of these mechanics misbehave.

country_capital_invalid_state.what: The capital value {value} of {country} is not a valid state ID
country_capital_invalid_state.impact: The country has no usable capital; consequences as above.

country_capital_not_owned.what: The capital {state} of {country} is owned by {owner}
country_capital_not_owned.impact: The game rejects the capital and logs an error — the engine falls back to a capital of its own choosing.
country_capital_not_owned.action: Change the capital or the ownership

map_state_no_land.what: State {name} (#{state_id}) is only a lake, with no land
map_state_no_land.impact: The game has nowhere to place this state's air base, rocket site and stronghold and crashes when a game starts; error.log stays empty on a normal start.
map_state_no_land.action: Open the map studio and click Fix, or ask the assistant to fix it, then export again

country_history_final_winner_ambiguous.what: {country} has history files from multiple sources; the effective one cannot be determined
country_history_final_winner_ambiguous.impact: The effective start setup may not be your latest edit.

country_history_final_winner_inferred.what: {country} has history files from multiple sources; {path} was chosen by load order

country_research_slots_missing.impact: The game uses the default value.

country_research_slots_invalid.what: The research slot count {value} of {country} is invalid
country_research_slots_invalid.impact: The line does not take effect; slots fall back to the default.

playtest_crash.what: The game crashed during the playtest (type: {exception})
playtest_crash.impact: The report carries the crash type and game version; usually enough to pinpoint the content.

playtest_start_date_mismatch.what: The start date the game actually loaded ({a}) differs from the design ({b})
playtest_start_date_mismatch.impact: Players enter the wrong era — history content designed for {b} may fire completely out of order. Common root cause: the outer .mod file lacks replace_path="common/bookmarks".

playtest_runtime_diagnostics_input_inval.what: The playtest log could not be read

playtest_loaded_start_date.what: Confirmed start date loaded by the game: {date}
playtest_loaded_start_date.impact: Informational; counts toward ✅ when it matches the design.

playtest_enabled_mods.what: Confirmed the mod list enabled during the playtest
playtest_enabled_mods.impact: Informational; used to rule out mod conflicts.

playtest_start_date_ok.what: The start date matches the design

oob_air_location_missing.what: Air wing {name} has no state set
oob_air_location_missing.impact: The wing does not appear at game start.
oob_air_location_missing.action: Set the state (requires an air base)

oob_air_location_invalid.what: The state {id} of air wing {name} is invalid
oob_air_location_invalid.impact: The wing does not appear at game start; wings must be based in a state with an air base.

oob_air_equipment_type_missing.what: Air wing {name} has no equipment type
oob_air_equipment_type_missing.impact: The wing does not appear at game start.

oob_air_equipment_type_invalid.what: The equipment type {value} of air wing {name} does not exist
oob_air_equipment_type_invalid.impact: The wing does not appear at game start.

building_state_coordinate_mismatch.what: Building {id} is declared in state {a}, but its coordinates fall in state {b}
building_state_coordinate_mismatch.impact: The game ignores the building — it does not appear; the error is logged.
building_state_coordinate_mismatch.action: Fix the coordinates or the state

building_coordinate_membership_missing.what: The coordinates of building {id} fall in province {province}, which belongs to no state
building_coordinate_membership_missing.impact: Produces a map error and the building is ignored.
building_coordinate_membership_missing.action: Assign the province to a state

building_reference_province_invalid.what: Building {id} needs a valid {kind} reference province; the current value is {value}
building_reference_province_invalid.impact: Naval bases must point to an adjacent sea province; with an invalid one the port is unusable.

duplicate_expected_province.what: The program's reference data self-check failed (duplicate province list)
duplicate_expected_province.impact: The UI will show “check incomplete”; reported automatically.

duplicate_province_within_state.impact: Duplicates are ignored — usually harmless, but it signals a data source problem.

duplicate_state_input.impact: Only one takes effect; your edits may be overwritten by the other.

province_in_multiple_states.what: Province {province} belongs to both state {a} and state {b}
province_in_multiple_states.action: Remove it from one of them

province_without_state.impact: The game runs, but pops a MAP_ERROR warning in game.

unknown_province.impact: The reference is dropped as an invalid token and an error is logged; the rest of the state loads normally.

bookmark_raw_no_bookmark.what: No bookmark could be parsed from bookmark file {path}
bookmark_raw_no_bookmark.impact: The start does not appear on the campaign selection screen.

bookmark_raw_path_case_collision.what: Two bookmark files differ only in letter case ({a} / {b})
bookmark_raw_path_case_collision.impact: On Windows only one takes effect, on Linux both do — behavior differs across platforms.

descriptor_imported_replace_paths_requir.what: This mod carries directory-level replace_path rules, but “export self-built content only” is selected
descriptor_imported_replace_paths_requir.impact: The game unloads entire vanilla directories with nothing to replace them — large amounts of content go missing.

descriptor_replace_path_empty.what: replace_path “{path}” unloads a vanilla directory, but the export package has no files under it
descriptor_replace_path_empty.impact: Everything in that directory will be missing in game.
descriptor_replace_path_empty.action: Add files or remove the rule

ideology_root_invalid.impact: Writes a broken common/ideologies — the ruling party setup of every country referencing it fails.

ideology_root_submod_blocked.what: Replacing the ROOT ideology inside a submod
ideology_root_submod_blocked.impact: This would wipe the base mod's ideology definitions.
ideology_root_submod_blocked.action: Use the ROOT provided by the base mod, or make this a standalone mod

raid_path_unsafe.what: Raid file {path} was skipped because of an unsafe path
raid_path_unsafe.impact: Its content was not imported into the project.

raid_deps_not_carried.what: Files the raids depend on were not imported along
raid_deps_not_carried.impact: The raids may be unavailable in game.

unit_path_unsafe.what: Sub-unit file {path} was skipped because of an unsafe path
unit_path_unsafe.impact: Its content was not imported into the project.

factions_path_unsafe.what: Faction file {path} was skipped because of an unsafe path
factions_path_unsafe.impact: Its content was not imported into the project.

loc_entry_unpreserved.what: {count} localisation entries were not preserved during import
loc_entry_unpreserved.impact: These texts are not included in the export.

state_raw_parse_failed.what: State file {path} has a syntax error
state_raw_parse_failed.impact: All states in this file will be missing.

sub_unit_classification_invalid.what: The classification of sub-unit “{id}” is invalid: {reason}
sub_unit_classification_invalid.impact: The game errors when loading the sub-unit.

sub_unit_source_file_collision.what: Sub-unit “{id}” would be written to “{path}”, overwriting an existing sub-unit definition file
sub_unit_source_file_collision.impact: The other sub-units in the original file will be missing.
sub_unit_source_file_collision.action: Let the program assign the filename

base_id_collision_rerouted.what: A new ID collided with the base mod and was renamed automatically: {oldId} → {newId}
base_id_collision_rerouted.impact: No impact on the game; base mod content is untouched. Use the new ID in later references.

non_additive_base_history_override.what: Blocked a direct rewrite of the history file of base mod country {tag}
non_additive_base_history_override.impact: A direct rewrite overrides the original mod's setup and can conflict or even CTD; an additive alternative was provided.

gateway_tool_passthrough_failed_sdk_emit.what: AI gateway routing error; this tool call did not run
gateway_tool_passthrough_failed_sdk_emit.impact: That AI step did not take effect.

content_language_export_languages_missin.what: {language} content exists, but that language is not enabled for export
content_language_export_languages_missin.impact: The content is not packaged; the game shows localisation keys instead.

display_name_placeholder.impact: They show as IDs in game.

effect_typo.what: “{token}” is likely a typo; suggested replacement: “{suggestion}”
effect_typo.impact: The line does not take effect with no in-game hint; diagnosing it requires error.log.

research_bonus_as_effect.what: research_bonus is written in an effect position
research_bonus_as_effect.impact: No effect; it must sit in a modifier position.

script_position_swap_ideas_child_outside.what: A swap_ideas child sits outside its parent block
script_position_swap_ideas_child_outside.action: Move it into the parent block

unknown_tech_category.impact: The technology appears on no tech tree tab and cannot be researched.

vanilla_seed_dlc_effects_absent.what: Projects seeded from vanilla do not include the extra content vanilla keeps in its own state script ({count} states affected)
vanilla_seed_dlc_effects_absent.impact: The province-level buildings stored in that script go missing — naval bases, bunkers, dams and landmarks — along with dated history blocks, DLC-conditional ownership transfers, resistance and compliance settings, and a few entries we do not read by name. Exporting these states overwrites the game's own files for them. The States page can restore this content from vanilla.

ideology_undefined_standalone.what: Character {id} uses an ideology that is not defined in this project
ideology_undefined_standalone.impact: The ideology definition is not written into the exported mod. Characters using it become a leader with no political party in game.

ideology_registry_parent_missing.impact: The ideology definition is not written into the exported mod. Characters using it become a leader with no political party in game.

focus_layout_same_cell.what: Focuses {focus_ids} sit in the same cell ({position})
focus_layout_same_cell.impact: Two focuses overlap; the game shows only one of them.

focus_layout_adjacent_same_row.what: Two focuses sit next to each other in the same row, one column apart
focus_layout_adjacent_same_row.impact: The focus icons overlap and are hard to read or click. Nothing is lost.

focus_display_name_unproven_fallback.what: Focus {focus_id} has no {locale} name in this project
focus_display_name_unproven_fallback.impact: The focus name may not be localised in game.

idea_no_modifier.impact: It appears on the country but grants no bonus or penalty.

character_no_military_traits.impact: The character can be appointed but brings no bonus.

bookmark_selectable_ideology_missing.what: Selectable country {country_tag} in the bookmark has no ideology
bookmark_selectable_ideology_missing.impact: The leader, party icon and country name may display incorrectly on the country-select screen.

focus_tree_no_nodes.impact: The tree is empty; the focus screen shows nothing.

localisation_reference_not_in_project.what: {id} references localisation key {loc_key}, which is not in this project
localisation_reference_not_in_project.impact: The text renders as the key itself.

mod_folder_name.what: Mod folder name {folder} contains characters HOI4 does not accept
mod_folder_name.impact: The exported folder is renamed; the name shown in the launcher does not change.

province_double_mapping.what: Province {province_id} belongs to states {state_ids} at the same time
province_double_mapping.action: Remove the province from one state

doctrine_track_unresolved.what: Doctrine {id} points at a track that is in neither this project nor the base mod
doctrine_track_unresolved.impact: If the base mod removed that track, the doctrine tree may render incorrectly.
doctrine_track_unresolved.action: Point it at an existing track

event_namespace_mismatch.what: The event ID prefix does not match its namespace
event_namespace_mismatch.impact: Callers may not find it and the event never fires.
event_namespace_mismatch.action: Align the prefix with the namespace

event_no_options.impact: The event pops up with no button to click.

tech_circular_prereq.what: Technology {tech_id} and another technology require each other
tech_circular_prereq.impact: Not measured; the in-game effect is unknown.

tech_folder_unknown.what: Technology {id} has a folder the game does not know
tech_folder_unknown.impact: Not measured; the in-game effect is unknown.

focus_effective_default_multiple.what: Several focus trees are marked default at once ({default_tree_ids})
focus_effective_default_multiple.impact: Not measured; the in-game effect is unknown.

focus_created_primary_id_collision.what: Focus tree {tree_id} writes to {canonical_path}, which already holds other content
focus_created_primary_id_collision.impact: Not measured; the in-game effect is unknown.

focus_shared_pool_scope_ignored.what: The sharing scope set on focus tree {tree_id} has no effect on export
focus_shared_pool_scope_ignored.impact: Not measured; the in-game effect is unknown.
focus_shared_pool_scope_ignored.jump: Focus trees › this tree › Sharing scope

impassable_category_mismatch.what: {count} impassable states use a category vanilla never pairs with impassable
impassable_category_mismatch.impact: Impassable blocks troop entry and provincial building construction, and the state shows as impassable terrain in game. Vanilla only pairs it with wasteland or enclave, so a different category usually means the flag was set by accident. Nothing is blocked and no data is changed — worth a look before you ship.

impassable_without_force_link.what: {count} impassable states do not say which neighbouring state owns them
impassable_without_force_link.impact: Impassable land has no owner of its own, so it needs a neighbouring state to inherit ownership from. Vanilla sets force_link_ownership_to on all 21 of its impassable states (measured on 1.19.2 — this field is not in the wiki). Nothing is blocked and no data is changed — only newly saved states are required to fill it in.
impassable_without_force_link.action: Open each state and pick the neighbouring state that should own it

bookmark_filter_registry_missing.what: The scenario filters could not be checked
bookmark_filter_registry_missing.impact: The project has no supported target game version, so filter compatibility is unverified.

bookmark_default_multiple.what: {default_count} scenarios are marked as the default
bookmark_default_multiple.impact: The intended opening scenario is ambiguous.

bookmark_default_country_not_interesting.what: The default country {default_country} is not in this scenario’s selectable countries
bookmark_default_country_not_interesting.impact: The game may not preselect the country you intended.

bookmark_country_label_invalid.what: A scenario country has an unsupported filter label
bookmark_country_label_invalid.impact: That country may not appear under the intended filter.

bookmark_country_labels_filter_missing.what: Countries have labels, but the label filter is not enabled
bookmark_country_labels_filter_missing.impact: Players cannot use those labels to filter the country list.

bookmark_filter_invalid_for_target.what: A scenario filter is not supported by the target game version
bookmark_filter_invalid_for_target.impact: The filter may not work as intended in game.

bookmark_filter_country_label_semantics.what: Country labels have been used as scenario filters
bookmark_filter_country_label_semantics.impact: The filter buttons may not show the intended countries.

focus_layout_missing_focus_id.what: A focus has no script ID
focus_layout_missing_focus_id.impact: The game cannot reliably identify or reference this focus.

focus_layout_duplicate_focus_id.what: More than one focus uses the ID {focus_id}
focus_layout_duplicate_focus_id.impact: References to this ID may point to the wrong focus.

focus_layout_relative_cycle.what: Focus positions refer back to one another: {cycle}
focus_layout_relative_cycle.impact: The game cannot resolve all relative positions in this loop.

focus_layout_missing_anchor.what: Focus {focus_id} refers to missing position anchor {relative_position_id}
focus_layout_missing_anchor.impact: Its relative position cannot be resolved in this output.

focus_layout_replacement_global_shift.what: The replacement focus tree has been moved as a whole
focus_layout_replacement_global_shift.impact: Its alignment with other branches may have changed.

focus_layout_unknown_mode.what: The focus layout check could not complete
focus_layout_unknown_mode.impact: The program could not interpret this tree’s layout mode; its layout remains unverified.

timeline_base_timeline_source_unregister.what: The base mod’s campaign dates have not been verified
timeline_base_timeline_source_unregister.impact: The chosen dates may differ from the base mod’s timeline.
